title: After School
text:
Maria is sixteen years old. She goes to school in the morning, and after school she works at a small café on Fridays. She likes her job because she meets many friends there. She saves her money to buy a new phone.

On weekends, Maria plays football with her brother in the park. Sometimes they invite their friends too. Her parents think sport is good for her health. Maria says that a healthy body helps her study better.

questions.text: What does Maria play with her brother on weekends?
Why does Maria work at the café?
options: She wants to save money for a phone
Her parents make her work there
She wants to become a cook

questions.text: What can we infer about Maria's parents?
options: They do not care about sport
They want her to stop school

vocabulary.definition: to ask someone to come to an event or place
a small place where people buy drinks and food

paragraph_translations: María tiene dieciséis años. Ella va a la escuela por la mañana, y después de la escuela trabaja en una cafetería pequeña los viernes. Le gusta su trabajo porque conoce a muchos amigos allí. Ahorra su dinero para comprar un teléfono nuevo.

Los fines de semana, María juega fútbol con su hermano en el parque. A veces, ellos también invitan a sus amigos. Sus padres piensan que el deporte es bueno para su salud. María dice que un cuerpo sano la ayuda a estudiar mejor.
